list.name: group
list.label: Global Collection
list.query: SELECT gc_name AS __text, gc_rec_ID AS __value FROM reporting.globalcollection ORDER BY gc_name
list.definition: SELECT gc_name AS __text, gc_rec_ID AS __value FROM reporting.globalcollection ORDER BY gc_name

list.name: devices
list.label: Devices
list.query: SELECT e.entity_name AS __text, e.current_model_key AS __value FROM reporting.entity e JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=e.current_model_key WHERE dm.destroy_time IS NULL AND (-1 IN ($group) OR e.current_model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT e.entity_name AS __text, e.current_model_key AS __value FROM reporting.entity e JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=e.current_model_key WHERE dm.destroy_time IS NULL AND (-1 IN ($group) OR e.current_model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM reporting.devicemodel dm WHERE dm.destroy_time IS NULL AND (-1 IN ($group) OR dm.model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) AND (-1 IN ($devices) OR dm.model_key IN ($devices))

panels.title: Asset Inventory — sortable; click any column header

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.entity_name AS `Name`, dm.IP, mc.mclass_name AS `Class`, v.vendor_name AS `Vendor`, dm.device_type AS `Type`, dm.serial_nbr AS `Serial`, dm.fw_rev AS `FW Rev`, CASE WHEN dm.last_reboot > '1970-01-05' THEN DATE_FORMAT(dm.last_reboot,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') ELSE 'N/A' END AS `Last Reboot`, NULLIF(dm.location,'') AS `Location`, NULLIF(dm.contact_person,'') AS `Contact`, NULLIF(dm.cust_asset_tag,'') AS `Asset Tag`, NULLIF(dm.cust_asset_ID,'') AS `Asset ID`, NULLIF(dm.cust_asset_owner,'') AS `Owner`, NULLIF(dm.cust_asset_organization,'') AS `Organization`, NULLIF(dm.cust_asset_office,'') AS `Office` FROM reporting.devicemodel dm JOIN reporting.entity e ON e.current_model_key=dm.model_key JOIN reporting.vendor v ON v.vendor=dm.vendor JOIN reporting.modelclass mc ON mc.model_class=dm.model_class WHERE dm.destroy_time IS NULL AND (-1 IN ($group) OR dm.model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) AND (-1 IN ($devices) OR dm.model_key IN ($devices)) ORDER BY e.entity_name
